cirque-colors-nail-polish: Praised for a smooth, self-leveling formula; many find sheer jellies need three or four coats.
cnd-solaroil: Liked for stronger nails and less peeling; many find the scent strong, especially after a change.
dazzle-dry-nail-lacquer: Loved for drying in minutes without a lamp and lasting well; some find it chips within days.
deborah-lippmann-nail-lacquer: Praised for an easy, glossy, long-lasting formula; some find it streaky or not worth the price.
essie-break-fix-liquid-nail-patch: Liked for patching peeling layers and small cracks; a couple say it fails on bigger splits.
essie-gel-couture: Loved for a glossy, plump finish lasting a week or more; many find it shrinks, especially in thick coats.
essie-gel-couture-top-coat: Liked for a plump, glossy finish that lasts a week; many find it shrinks at the tips.
essie-gel-setter-top-coat: Loved for a thick, gel-like shine; many find shrinkage the most frequent complaint.
essie-good-to-go-top-coat: Praised for fast drying and a glossy finish; a few still see shrinkage or stickiness.
essie-hard-to-resist-advanced-nail-stren: Valued for strengthening thin, brittle nails and cutting peeling; few real complaints.
essie-nail-polish: Liked for easy application, gloss and creme shades; many find it chips within days.
essie-speed-setter-fast-dry-top-coat: Loved for very fast drying and a week or more of wear; a few say it gets gummy mid-bottle.
essie-strong-start-base-coat: Liked as a gentle base that helps with peeling; a few say it did not help.
glamnetic-press-on-nails: Liked for one to three weeks of wear with strong glue; several find removal slow and difficult.
holo-taco-nail-oil-pen: Loved as a mess-free, quick-absorbing way to apply oil; a couple had one that leaked or broke.
holo-taco-nail-polish: Praised for opaque, often one-coat cremes lasting a week; many find the formula thick.
ilnp-nail-polish: Liked for good formulas and value; many find bottles thicken over months and need thinner.
kiss-colorfx-by-impress: Liked for easy application, removal and good value; some dislike the exposed sticky edge.
kiss-impress-press-on-manicure: Liked for a week or two of natural-looking wear with no damage; some find they lift within days.
manucurist-green-nail-polish: Liked for a thin, quick-drying formula that is gentle on nails; some need two coats for opacity.
mooncat-getting-even-nail-primer: Loved for smoothing ridges and gentle, fast-drying wear; a few say it does not last long enough.
mooncat-nail-polish: Praised for wearing longer than other brands; many find the thick formula needs thinner.
mooncat-speed-demon-top-coat: Loved for fast, hard drying and a glossy finish; many find it turns thick and stringy mid-bottle.
olive-june-gel-polish: Liked as easy for beginners with good results; some find certain shades sheer.
olive-june-pressies: Praised for a good fit and about two weeks of wear; a couple say the kids' size would not stay on.
opi-repair-mode-bond-building-nail-serum: Liked for quickly strengthening weak, peeling nails; a notable group report lifting or dryness.
opi-xpress-on: Praised for lasting two weeks or more; a few find the curve too strong or the tips splitting.
orly-gelfx-builder-in-a-bottle: Liked as easy for beginners with long wear; many find shaping the thick formula takes practice.
orly-nail-lacquer: Liked for an easy formula, comfortable brush and big bottles; some find chipping or sheer pale shades.
sally-hansen-color-therapy: Liked for lasting a week or more and easy application; a couple found it chipped in chunks.
sally-hansen-dries-instantly-top-coat: Loved for very fast drying and shiny results; a couple found it cracked their polish.
sally-hansen-hard-as-nails: Liked as a cheap base that helps polish last; others say it made nails brittle or did nothing.
sally-hansen-insta-dri-top-coat: Valued for fast drying at a low price; many find chipping or cracking the main complaint.
sally-hansen-miracle-gel: Loved for lasting a week or more without a lamp; some find chipping or a thick formula.
sally-hansen-miracle-gel-top-coat: Liked for shine, minimal shrinkage and long wear; it dries slower than quick-dry options for some.
sally-hansen-vitamin-e-nail-cuticle-oil: Valued as a dependable store-bought cuticle oil people rebuy; few real complaints.
seche-vive-instant-gel-effect-top-coat: Liked for quick drying and a plump, gel-like shine; some dislike the strong smell and thickening.
